messages:
Evan: Heads-up 1: customers hitting client-side latency spikes because SDKs retry when server returns 413s. We should give SDKs a better contract: a split-preview endpoint + explicit backpressure hint header.
Sara: Agreed. Current 413 body is opaque. Idea: /v1/embeds/preview that returns lightweight split ranges and an estimated cost + backpressure_hint (0-100).
Devon: Preview should be super cheap: only inspect headers + first N bytes. Avoid decoding full payload. Response sample: 
```
POST /v1/embeds/preview
H: X-Embed-Dims: 1024
Body: [...stream...] (peeked)
200 {"split_hint": [{"start":0,"end":1500}], "est_compute_units": 2300, "backpressure_hint": 70}
```
Nadia: Backpressure_hint semantics: 0 = no pressure (ok to send), 100 = heavy pressure (recommend client throttle). We'll map routing policies to thresholds in the SDK.
Evan: Telemetry: preview.request, preview.cache_hit, preview.suggested_split_applied, preview.rejected. Include tenant_id, sdk_version, orig_size_bytes.
Sara: Console: add a per-tenant "Embed Health" card showing preview_hit_ratio, avg_backpressure, median_est_units. Also show last_preview_examples with anonymized shapes.
Devon: SDK change: on 413, SDK should call preview endpoint once (unless a preview header already returned), then either apply server suggestion or fall back to client-split. Add a fast-path: if server returns X-Embed-Suggested-Split header, use it without separate preview call.
Nadia: Security: preview must not store or forward vector contents. Only record aggregates. Ensure S3/lazy-logs scrub contents.
Evan: Quotas: introduce 'embed_compute_units' as quota unit. preview should not consume quota; only actual embed requests count, but preview increments a cheap telemetry meter.
Sara: Rollout plan: feature-flag preview + header on 3% traffic for 72h. Console opt-in for tenants to see preview examples. Add canary dashboard.
Devon: Edge-case: mixed dimensions in one request. Preview should detect this and return explain: ["mixed_dims"], plus per-range dims if possible. If mixed and cannot split safely, preview advises client to split.
Nadia: Client API: add header `X-Embed-Prefer-Preview: true` for SDKs to indicate they want preview first. Also `X-Embed-Accept-Estimate: true` to get est_compute_units in 200 responses.
Evan: Logs from my local canary: 
`2026-03-21T04:02:18Z preview: request tenant=globe sdk=python est_units=1820 backpressure=45 cache=miss`
`2026-03-21T04:02:18Z preview: cache_hit tenant=globe dims=1024`
Sara: Billing: product asked whether est_compute_units should be surfaced in invoice. We recommend not billing for estimates; only charge for produced embeddings. Add note in docs.
Devon: UX: Console preview card should provide a copyable curl that applies the suggested split automatically (with a generated small script). Also surface a quick switch: "Apply server-split next time" (tenant-level opt-in).
Nadia: Instrumentation: preview_latency_ms, preview_parse_bytes, preview_cache_hit_ratio, preview_triggered_from_413. Tag with routing_node.
Evan: Ops: create alert when preview_error_rate > 0.2% over 5m. Also page if backpressure_avg > 80 for 10m.
OpsBot: Alert created: preview_error_rate > 0.2% over 5m on /v1/embeddings -> notify eng-sre. Alert created: embed_backpressure_avg > 80 over 10m -> paging eng-sre.
Sara: Docs: add a section in embedding best practices for preview-based client throttling and include SDK examples.
Devon: I'll draft the preview handler (peek-only parser) and a light in-memory LRU cache keyed by (tenant, dims_hint, avg_bytes_per_vector) TTL 6m.
Nadia: I'll draft a minimal telemetry spec and data retention constraints for preview events.
Evan: Next steps: Devon prototypes in a canary branch, Sara wires Console card and docs, Nadia sets telemetry+security review. We'll sync in tomorrow's eng-platform sync. :rocket:
